GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OF PROVINCIAL COUNCIL ACT, NO. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SIXTH SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH SEPTEMBER, 2017

An order to provide for the services during the year from 01st January, 2025 to 31st December, 2025, to authorize the raising of loans within the province of Sabaragamuwa for the purpose of such service, to make financial provisions in respect of certain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during that year, to enable the payment, by way of advances out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of, or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund, and to make provision for matters connected with or incidental to the aforesaid matter.
BE it enacted by me, the Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Province of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows.

1. I do hereby grant permission unto the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Province to spend Rupees Sixty one billion seven hundred thirty eight million one hundred and thirty eight thousand only, (Rs. 61,738,138,000/-) and which estimated for the services of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the One year duration beginning on 01st January, 2025 and ending on 31st December, 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under section 27(A) of Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987 as the term of the Sixth Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council ended on 26th September, 2017.
2. (1). Without prejudice to any other law authorizing any expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which estimate will be Rupees Sixty one billion seven hundred.

5. The debit balance, outstanding at the end of financial year 2025 of any activity specified in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall not exceed the maximum limit specified in the corresponding entry in column (vii) of that schedule, and the total liabilities of that activity at the end of that financial year shall not exceed the maximum limit specified in the corresponding entry column (viii) of that schedule.

6. Whenever at any time during the financial year 2025, the receipts of that Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council from any activity specified in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order are insufficient to meet the expenditure incurred by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council on such activity, the governor may, from time to time, by order direct that such sums may deem necessary to meet such expenditure shall be payable by way of advances out of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, so however that the aggregate of the sums so advances does not exceed the maximum limit of entry in column (v) of that schedule. Any sums so advanced in respect of such activity shall be refunded to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund in such manner as the Governor may by order direct.

7. (1). Any money which, by virtue of the provisions of the first schedule to this order, have been allocated to recurrent expenditure under any programme appearing under any head specified in that schedule but have not been expended or may likely to be unexpended, may be transferred to the allocation of recurrent expenditure or capital expenditure under any other programme within that head by order of the Chief Secretary to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or any other officer authorized by him.
Advance payments out of Provincial Council fund or any other fund for the activities mentioned in the paragraph 3 during the year 2025.
Power to transfer unexpected monies allocated to recurrent expenditure to another allocation within some programme or to another programme under the same head of expenditure

(2). Any money allocated to capital expenditure under any programme appearing under any head specified in the first schedule to this order shall be transferred out of that programme or project only by the Chief Secretary of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
8. (1). That the receipts from taxes and other sources will be less than the amount anticipated to finance authorized expenditure. Or;
(2). That amount originally appropriated for a particular purpose or purposes are no longer required;

He may with the approval of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, withdraw in whole, or in part, any amounts previously released for expenditure under the authority of a warrant issued by him from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or from any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
9. The Governor may, on or before 31st May, 2026, by order, vary or alter.
(a). Any of the maximum limits specified in column (v), column (vii) and column (viii) of the second schedule to this order.
(b). The maximum limits specified in column (vi) of the second schedule to this order.
No order made under this section shall have effect unless it has been approved by the Governor.
Any such order shall, if so, expressed therein be deemed to have had effect from such date prior to the date of making such order as may be specified therein.
10. The Governor may amend the second schedule to this order, by adding to the appropriate columns of that schedule any activity and,
(a). All or any of the maximum limits relating to such activity.
(b). The minimum limit relating to such activity.

11. This permission will be valid till 31st day of December, 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
A.A.C.J. Rajarathna, Hon. Governor - Sabaragamuwa province.
Power of Governor to vary the maximum and minimum limits specified in the second schedule to this order.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Rupees Sixty One Billion Seven Hundred Thirty Eight Million One Hundred and Thirty Eight Thousand only, (Rs. 61,738,138,000) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2025 and end on 31st of December, 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-starts the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
A.A.C.J. Rajarathne, Hon. Governor - Sabaragamuwa Province.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses stated in the Second (II) Schedule, which is estimated for the Advance Account Activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2025 and end on 31st December, 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017. Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.

This permission will be valid till 31st December, 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
A.A.C.J. Rajarathne, Hon. Governor - Sabaragamuwa Province.
